# SD13-E2 Half-Orc bounded race-semantics classification fixture.
#
# Deterministic Half-Orc Fighter level-1 character input chosen to drive the
# `race.semantics.unverified` diagnostic in `pilot_compute.rs`. The fixture
# carries a Half-Orc race identity (not Human) with NO Human-specific race
# semantics: the bounded non-race seam (Fighter chassis, ability modifiers,
# base saves, total saves, deterministic combat baseline) still grounds a
# `Computed` receipt because the race semantic gap is intentionally
# non-claim-blocking. There is no Half-Orc-specific ability-bonus or
# bonus-feat selection in this fixture (Half-Orc has no equivalent of the
# Human ability-bonus or bonus-feat pressure), so the deterministic Half-Orc
# pilot compute path receives only the generic `race.semantics.unverified`
# diagnostic and no Human race explanation records.
